entities.name: Thomas Regnaudin

entities.summary: Thomas Regnaudin was a French sculptor, affiliated with Northern Baroque. Some of Regnaudin's works were placed in the Apollo Gallery of the Louvre. A son of a stonemason, he was a pupil of Anguier.
